overview.about: The TOTO Japan Classic is the LPGA's long-standing event in Japan, a country with one of the deepest pools of women's golf talent in the world. Played each autumn, it is a highlight of the Asian swing and a big draw for local fans.
overview.nextEvent: The next TOTO Japan Classic is played on a championship course in Japan. Strong home support and a large contingent of Japanese stars make it one of the tour's most popular international weeks.
